column1: Number of degrees/certificates awarded at postsecondary institutions, by state and  gender: 2023-24
This table presents data collected from Title IV institutions in the United States. Prior to 2009-10, the data include only Title IV primarily postsecondary institutions.

The new Doctor's degree classifications of research/scholarship, professional practice, and other Doctor's degrees were optional in 2007-08 and 2008-09 and became mandatory in 2009-10. The old classifications of Doctor's degree, first-professional degree, and first-professional certificate were no longer reported after 2008-09. For information on comparing the old and new post-baccalaureate award classifications, go to https://nces.ed.gov/ipeds/report-your-data/data-tip-sheet-reporting-graduate-awards.

SOURCE: U.S. Department of Education, National Center for Education Statistics, Integrated Postsecondary Education Data System (IPEDS), Completions component final data (2001-02 - 2022-23) and provisional data (2023-24).
